sections.title: Arrival, payment, rules, and cancellation highlights.
content: Check-in is 3:00pm and check-out is 11:00am. The villa can try to accommodate arrival or departure outside these times when bookings permit. Check-outs after 3:00pm incur an additional charge.

To secure a booking, a damage deposit equal to one night stay plus 20% of the total is required. The remaining balance is arranged in installments, with 40% due two months prior to arrival and 40% due one month prior to arrival. Ask about the payment plan when booking.
The damage deposit is refundable within five days of departure, less damages if any. Full bank-payment details are shared directly during booking rather than published on the website.

Events or commercial activities require prior agreement from villa management and charges may apply. The villa is in a residential area, so guests should be considerate of neighbours and loud music should stop by 11:00pm.
Children under 18 must be supervised at the pool. Guests should keep keys and gate remote secure, return dishes to their units, avoid moving furniture, and avoid tampering with villa equipment.

We keep personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this policy, including to respond to inquiries, maintain records, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements. We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards designed to protect personal information. No website, email, hosting provider, or internet transmission can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

Depending on your location, you may have rights to request access, correction, deletion, portability, restriction, objection, withdrawal of consent, opt out of sale, sharing, targeted advertising, or certain profiling, limit use of sensitive personal information, and appeal or complain to a regulator. We will not discriminate against you for exercising rights that apply to you. To make a request, use the contact details provided on this website.

Strictly necessary technologies are used to make the website work, protect security, remember privacy choices, deliver pages, and support basic site functions. These are generally active because the website cannot operate properly without them.
Preference and functionality technologies may remember choices such as language, region, form progress, display settings, or similar preferences if those features are enabled.
